caption: Figure 6. Integration of RTOSUnits’ custom instructions into a full out-of-order core. The instruction queue is used to collect out-of-order issued custom instructions (a)/(b) and passes them in-order to the RTOSUnit (e).

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from n-panel-comparison by the note-writer: a single pipeline diagram with lettered arrows (a)-(e) indexing prose explanations of signals, not separate comparison panels; there is only one frame here, not multiple copies of a drawing.
templates.what_to_learn: Reserve lettered tags for indexing prose explanations of individual signals on one diagram (as this figure correctly does) rather than assuming letters always mean separate panels; box exactly the stages that changed (here the out-of-order I/X/W group) and colour only the new components, leaving the rest uncoloured.
